---
name: Feature proposal
about: Propose a feature or an evolution of an existing one
title: "[proposal] "
labels: proposal
---

## What you observed

What happened, or what you could not see, in your own words. Include the view, the version (Config → About), and what the fleet was doing.

## The reading

What would measure this? Name the numbers, where they come from (transcripts, the board, the receipts), and what they count.

## The actor

Which non-human decision consumes that reading: a prompt, a priority, a cadence, a seat choice, a gate. A reading only the operator reads is half a feature.

## The falsifier

What observation, by when, would prove this feature wrong or unneeded?

## The cost

Tokens per day, time per turn, disk, or attention. Say what it removes as well as what it adds.

## The deletion alternative

What could be removed instead of adding this?

## Laws touched

Does this touch the guard, the bridge, the inbox, Motus Max, a key, or the broadcast? If yes, say how the relevant law in `CONTRIBUTING.md` still holds.
